2025_firewall.resolver_season_gate: none (mathematics only; P12-5 owns the serving gate)

availability_statistics.method: 30 s replay grid x all drivers; descriptive, thresholds frozen
availability_statistics.note: STALE ~0% expected (max feed gap ~3.8 s); UNAVAILABLE tails are retired drivers

availability_thresholds.float_note: ownership decided on computed float age; 100.0 + nextafter(3.0) rounds to 103.0 (-> FRESH)

cache_contract.hit_guard: manifest identities (observation + geometry hash) + artifact file stats (mtime/size)
cache_contract.invalidation: explicit invalidate(race_id=None); drift reloads through fail-closed load (tested: replaced parquet raises provenance, never serves stale)
cache_contract.level: race-level only; no global corpus preload

causal_audit.method: deterministic seed 1204; 40 sampled COMPLETE/PARTIAL races x 8 (driver, T) queries vs independent pandas-mask reference

causal_rule: latest observation_time_s <= T via searchsorted(side=right) - 1; no nearest-neighbor, no backfill, no interpolation; negative age fails closed
clock_contract: T = anchor_state_time_s (ReplayFrame.anchor_state_time_s == RaceState.state_time_s); no second clock
driver_identity: canonical (race_id, driver_number); driver_id carried, never joined on; one-to-one mapping enforced, ambiguous fails closed; universe from live RaceState via structural read (no spatial->replay import)
entry_gate: all P12-4 boxes green; P12-5 not started

golden_validation.reference: independent pandas boolean-mask max (separate code path from searchsorted); render within 1e-12 of stored transform

known_limitations: cold load ~2 s/race paid once per cache residency; warm resolution sub-ms
availability ownership on computed float age (see availability_thresholds.float_note)
outside_viewport 0.0% on Bahrain 2023 (bounds include pit branch); flag exists for runoff/incident/noise on other circuits
window render coordinates only with verified geometry, else raw-only
empty universe resolves zero-driver coverage (caller choice)

memory_measurements.note: exact byte counts; backend-reasonable, no optimization undertaken

performance_measurements.verdict: comfortably interactive; no optimization needed, no target invented

pit_validation.verdict: raw pit trajectory returned verbatim, never snapped to main_track or pit_lane geometry

query_time_domain: finite numbers only (NaN/inf/non-numeric rejected); negative T resolves all-UNAVAILABLE; history window finite and >= 0
resolver_contract: spatial-resolver-v1 (raceintel/spatial/resolver.py: SpatialDriverState, SpatialFrame, TrajectorySample, DriverUniverseEntry, RaceSpatialStore, SpatialStoreCache, resolve_driver, resolve_frame, resolve_window, universe_from_race_state)

scientific_identities.note: reverified without regeneration via frozen test surface + zero diff on frozen paths

test_inventory.new_file: tests/test_spatial_resolver.py (synthetic series/tmp dirs; corpus integration outside CI)
test_inventory.reason: P12-4 resolver tests, source-safe, no corpus

unsupported_races.2024-r09-R: FAILED observations, SKIPPED geometry -> SpatialArtifactUnavailableError; untouched

window_contract: resolve_window returns ascending TrajectorySample within [T - history, T]; no future endpoint, no interpolation; feeds P12-5 trails / P12-6 tweening
